paragraphs: Posted by Leo. Hi, my name is Leo, and my bag is very untidy today. Yesterday, we played football at school. I was tired, so I put my things in the bag fast. Now I can't find my lucky sock! Lily says, "Your bag looks like a zoo." My mom says, "Please tidy your bag, Leo." I want to find my sock before the club hour on Thursday. I have an idea. I will put my things in groups. Teacher Kim says, "Words in a group are easy to remember."
Group one is for the head. It has the words head, hat, and sunglasses. A hat goes on the head. My blue hat is on top of my books. My sunglasses are next to it, and they are not broken.

Group two is for the arm and the hand. It has the words elbow, hand, finger, and glove. A glove goes on the hand. A finger is a part of the hand. I have one glove in my bag, but I don't have the other one. I think the other glove is at school. There is a spot of mud on my elbow. I have just cleaned it with water.

Group three is for the foot. It has the words foot, toe, sock, and trainers. A toe is a part of the foot. My trainers are very dirty after the match. One sock has a hole at the toe. Then I see something red under my trainers. It is my lucky sock! I am lucky today.

Teacher Kim reads my post, and she says, "It is a good post." Now my bag is tidy, and each group has a place. Which group do you like best? Can you make three groups with the things in your bag? Write the words on a paper and send it to me. Leo
text.summary: Leo writes a blog post about his untidy bag after football. He puts his things in three groups of words, for the head, for the arm and the hand, and for the foot, and he finds his lucky sock.
